value.description: The ID (GUID), name, path or definition of the object to be referred to.

object.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the object which has the reference.

platform.description: The ID (GUID) or unique name of the platform to link the reference. Set to null-guid for unlinked reference.

reference.description: The name of the reference to set. See \ref wobjects_index for more information on the references available.

description: Sets an object's reference value. See \ref wobjects_index for more information on the references available on each object type.

examples.description: Sets the Output Bus on the specified object.
examples.title: Setting an object reference
